title: Icathian Rain resolves only one 'Deal 2 to a unit' instance instead of six
expected: Enriched card def for ogn-248-298 (verified via getAllCards()) has six separate {type:'spell', effect:{type:'damage',amount:2,target:{type:'unit'}}} abilities. The engine only ever uses the first: play-spell.ts:956 `const spellAbility = abilities.find((a) => a.type === "spell")` stores that single effect on the chain (addToChain at :984), and the enumerator/condition (play-spell.ts:210, :411, :829) and resolve fallback (chain/resolve.ts:91) likewise use `.find`. No code folds multiple spell abilities into a sequence, so only one 'Deal 2 to a unit' instance with one target is resolved; the other five are dropped.
observed: playSpell moves enumerate a single target (targets:[one id]); chain item is a single {type:'damage',amount:2,target:{type:'unit'}}; after resolving, the chosen unit (Flame Chompers, 3 might) had damage=2 and the spell went to trash with no further prompts/pendingChoice for the remaining 5 instances. Other units took 0.
